caption: The drawing features a single transparent, slightly tapered drinking glass with a wide circular mouth and a thick, round base. The glass is centrally positioned on the paper, standing upright. Its surface is depicted with subtle shading and delicate highlights that suggest its glass material and convey its transparency. The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and light brown, with the background remaining a plain, off-white color, free of any additional objects or details. There are no visible liquid contents inside the glass, and the composition is minimalistic, with the glass occupying the central portion of the image and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Ale Schooner
